title: Characterizing neurotrophic factor-induced synaptic growth in primary mouse neuronal cultures
protocol: On DIV13, add purified recombinant NGPF2 or PBS as vehicle to the culture medium at a final concentration of 1.5 ng/mL.
Transfer a coverslip containing neurons treated with NGPF2 or PBS to a recording chamber on DIV14, 24–36 h post treatment.
Fill the glass recording pipette with intracellular solution.
Search and locate target neurons under the microscope for electrophysiological recording.
Immerse the tip of the recording pipette in the ECF in the recording chamber.
Read the tip resistance.
Use only pipettes with a tip resistance of around 4–5 MΩ.
Replace ECF in the recording chamber after each recording.
Apply slight positive pressure to the pipette through tubing.
Guide the tip of the pipette to approach the target neuron.
By using the micromanipulator, slowly press the pipette tip onto the cell body until an obvious dimple is formed.
Release positive pressure and apply a subtle negative pressure to form the seal.
In pClamp software, switch from Bath to Patch.
Apply −65 mV voltage to facilitate the formation of Giga-ohm seal.
Once formed, apply a slight suction to rupture the cell membrane patch.
Form whole-cell patch configuration.
Clamp neurons at -65 mV throughout recordings in voltage clamp configuration.
Apply a -3 mV step pulse every 20 s to monitor series resistance during recording.
Include only recordings with a pipette-membrane seal greater than one giga-ohm for statistical analysis.
Include only recordings where the drift of series resistance is less than 15% for analysis.
Analyze mEPSCs using MiniAnalysis Program (Synaptosoft).
On DIV14-15, add PBS as vehicle to culture medium.
Add recombinant NGPF2 protein at a final concentration of 1.5 ng/mL to the culture medium on DIV14-15.
Remove culture medium from coverslips on DIV15-16, 24–36 h post NGPF2 treatment.
Quickly wash coverslips with pre-cold PBS.
Fix cortical neurons with ice-cold 4% paraformaldehyde and 4% sucrose in PBS for 30 min at 4°C.
Remove the paraformaldehyde solution after fixing.
Wash coverslips in PBS for 5 min on a platform shaker (60 rpm).
Repeat washing 3 times.
Block the fixed cells from step 15 with 5% fetal bovine serum (FBS) diluted in PBS for 1 h at room temperature.
Wash with PBS for 5 min, 3 times.
Incubate coverslips with an antibody against the extracellular N-terminal domain of GluA2 (GluA2-NTD) at 1:500 dilution in PBS for 12–16 h at 4°C on a platform shaker (20 rpm).
Remove primary antibody solution and wash cells with PBS for 5 min, 3 times.
Add a secondary antibody (Alexa Fluor 488 donkey anti-mouse IgG) at 1:1000 dilution in PBS, incubate at room temperature for 1 h on a platform shaker (20 rpm).
Remove secondary antibody solution and wash with PBS for 5 min, 5 times.
Pipette 8 μL ProLong™ Gold Antifade Mountant on the surface of a glass slide.
Mount coverslips on slides with neurons facing down.
Permeabilize fixed cells from step 15 with 0.25% Triton X-100 in PBS for 10 min at room temperature, on a platform shaker (20 rpm).
Discard the solution and wash with PBS for 5 min, 3 times.
Add 500 μL 5% FBS in PBS for 1 h at room temperature.
Remove the blocking solution.
Wash with PBS for 5 min, repeating three times.
Incubate coverslips with primary antibodies against GluA2-NTD and Synapsin 1 in PBS at 1:1000 dilution for 12–16 hours at 4°C on a platform shaker (20 rpm).
Remove the primary antibody solution.
Wash with PBS for 5 min, repeating three times.
Add secondary antibodies diluted to 1:1000 in PBS and incubate at room temperature for 1 hour on a platform shaker (20 rpm).
Remove the secondary antibody solution.
Wash with PBS for 5 min, repeating five times.
Pipette 8 μL of ProLong™ Gold Antifade Mountant onto a glass slide surface.
Mount coverslips on slides with neurons facing down.
Incubate coverslips with primary antibodies against microtubule-associated protein 2 (MAP2) at 1:1000 dilution for 1 hour at room temperature on a platform shaker (20 rpm).
Remove the primary antibody solution.
Wash with PBS for 5 min, repeating three times.
Add secondary antibody and rhodamine phalloidin diluted to appropriate concentrations in PBS, incubate at room temperature for 1 hour on a platform shaker (20 rpm).
Remove secondary antibody solution.
Wash with PBS for 5 minutes, repeating 5 times.
Pipette 8 μL ProLong™ Gold Antifade Mountant on the surface of a glass slide.
Mount coverslips on slides with neurons facing down.
